comment: The sync mode parameter has no widget on the panel and lives only on the right-click menu. The frequency knob is a single snapped control from -96 to +96: anything at or above -1 is read as a multiplier of at least 1, so -1, 0 and 1 all give one pulse a beat, and below that the negative of the value becomes the divider (TrackerClock.cpp:82-92). The swing knob moves the point in the beat that counts as halfway, scaled by 0.9 so it never reaches the ends of the beat.
